annotations.title: Convert a salary to an hourly rate

description: Convert an annual salary to its gross hourly rate and the take-home pay per hour, for the hours a week and paid weeks a year given, in a tax year.

paidWeeksPerYear.description: Paid weeks a year; defaults to 52

scottishTaxpayer.description: True for a Scottish taxpayer (Scottish bands)

studentLoanPlan.description: Student loan plan, if any (plan4 is Scotland, postgrad the postgraduate loan)

taxYear.description: UK tax year, e.g. "2026-27". Defaults to the current one.
